verdict.rationale: The API supports the core verification workflow (creating sessions, polling/webhook decisions, HMAC auth) and even biometric liveness is 'available via API, web flow, and native SDKs' [veriff-docs-29], but several UI-exclusive capabilities—manual review/decision management, team administration, and PDF export—are documented as only available through the Customer Portal [veriff-docs-12, veriff-docs-13, veriff-docs-26, veriff-docs-47, veriff-docs-14], with no corresponding API endpoints mentioned. Missing for 10: API/programmatic access to manual review actions, team/user management endpoints, and PDF export equivalent.
